name: limit_detail_on_empty_space
why: REPORT 8CD843 N47 (round 13, 27/10/2026). The three details of a real drawing came out as empty circles in the PDF: the circle had become a detail circle of the view, the detail view was born, its label and scale were right, and nothing was in it. A detail that shows no edge is a box with nothing in it that reaches the workshop.
_what_changes_compared_to_the_twin: One argument: `x_mm`. The twin passes it as **55**, where the circle takes the right end of the plate (1 visible edge, measured); here it is left out, and the circle stays at the centre of the front view (120 x 20 mm at scale 1), inside the face, where the detail shows 0 visible edges (measured on 27/10/2026, scenario t40).
defect_caught: That the check on the visible edges disappears, or goes back to counting only the detail circles of the view: those went from 0 to 1 on the empty details of round 13 too. The message must say that the detail shows no edge, and that the view and the circle were removed.

expect.why: same part as the twin up to the step that changes
the part must be on disk before the view names it
the refusal must be the one on the empty detail, not the one on «it is not a drawing»
the view is there, and it is the place of the circle that is empty
